name: gta-claw
description: Self-governing AI Agent engine — pure empty shell that dynamically loads roles and skills from remote URLs

scripts.test:isolation-policy: node --input-type=module --eval "const assert = (await import('node:assert/strict')).default; const { selectIsolationMode } = await import('./dist/engine/toolExecutor.js'); delete process.env.NODE_ENV; delete process.env.GTA_CLAW_ALLOW_REDUCED_ISOLATION; assert.equal(selectIsolationMode(true), 'isolated-vm'); assert.throws(() => selectIsolationMode(false), /isolated-vm is required/); for (const [environment, optIn] of [['production', 'true'], ['development', ''], ['development', 'TRUE']]) assert.throws(() => selectIsolationMode(false, environment, optIn), /isolated-vm is required/); assert.equal(selectIsolationMode(false, 'development', 'true'), 'node-vm');"
